factProposals.value: Incident reports contain the incident details, its timeline, hours open, cause and linked risks, versioned per incident.
Incident and risk documentation is open to compliance officers, risk managers, security officers, TxDOT managers, the contract manager and system administrators only.

decisions.statement: Version control: a new report on an incident never replaces the old one; it is a new version that names the one it supersedes.
decisions.rationale: All reports must be version-controlled and logged.

limitations.statement: TxDOT's own incident management system (REQ-018) is not connected; reports draw on the incidents recorded in the workspace.
